title: Pathfinder 2e Classes

ratings.label: offense
ratings.description: Direct damage: single-target or area, burst and sustained. Either specialization can excel.

ratings.label: defense
ratings.description: Personal resilience: armor, saves, hit points and mitigation.

ratings.label: support
ratings.description: Helping allies: protection, healing, buffs, debuffs, control and granted actions.

ratings.label: utility
ratings.description: Solving noncombat problems through skills, spells and other tools.

ratings.label: complexity
ratings.description: Preparation, resource tracking, tactical decisions and rules knowledge. Higher means more to manage.

groups.label: Martial classes
groups.description: Weapon and unarmed combat, tactics and skills; some also use magic.

groups.label: Spellcasters
groups.description: Spellcasting is the main class framework.

groups.label: Hybrid & specialist classes
groups.description: Alchemy, impulses, runes, or a combination of spellcasting and martial abilities.

castingTypes.label: Prepared
castingTypes.description: Choose which spell goes into each slot at the start of the day, then cast those spells.

castingTypes.label: Spontaneous
castingTypes.description: Know a smaller repertoire of spells and cast any of them with any open slot of the right rank.

castingTypes.label: Prepared & spontaneous
castingTypes.description: Prepare most spells each morning, and cast a second set freely from a small repertoire.

statuses.label: Playtest
statuses.description: Public playtest; rules may change before print.

legend.howToUse: These are the original September 2026 numerical ratings, retained for comparison. They are informal opinions, not community consensus. Descriptions and families have been corrected; scores have not been recalibrated. See the revised set for the new rubric.
legend.choice: Solid squares reach the lower end; hatching extends to the upper end across different viable builds. The choices behind each range are explained on the website. A single build may not reach every upper endpoint.
